Fresh 471 tests/31 files, build, 160 desktop/mobile E2E (one worker), 2 Shade offline, 4 Bin Policy offline and 2 Shade base-path cases passed. Independent source replay identical; no Bin Policy methods/data/workflows or dependencies changed. See docs/shade-equity-delivery.md for actual evidence, source limitations, environmental flake and PR status.
